runners_data.name: Distant Shore
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with winning form who needs a strong pace to be effective, returning after 283 days off

runners_data.name: Karvala
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from a 239-day break with moderate recent form, needs significant improvement

races.paceDynamic: Town Queen will take the early lead with Perfect Ruler likely to sit close behind, creating a modest pace in this small field. With three hold-up horses (Distant Shore, Karvala, Porth Eilian) settling at the back, the gallop will be controlled and potentially tactical. The lack of multiple front-runners means Town Queen can dictate terms without significant early pressure. This measured pace scenario strongly favours the prominent racers and those with tactical speed over pure hold-up horses who need a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Town Queen leads uncontested with Perfect Ruler tracking close behind
scenarios.body: The modest early fractions allow the prominent pair to save energy for a sustained drive, while the hold-up trio face a tactical finish that may not suit. Town Queen's higher rating and recent form edge becomes decisive in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Positioning Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Perfect Ruler challenges Town Queen early or tries to lead
scenarios.body: The pace quickens as the two prominent runners engage, creating the strong gallop that suits Distant Shore's hold-up style and class advantage. The winner last time out can time her challenge perfectly as the early pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Finish
scenarios.trigger: If both prominent runners go too slow and create a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test over the final two furlongs, favouring horses with natural acceleration regardless of position. Distant Shore's class and Karvala's fresh condition from the long break could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Perfect Ruler Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Perfect Ruler improves significantly from the long break and gets first run
scenarios.body: The Haggas filly capitalizes on tactical positioning to steal a march on her rivals before they can respond. Her prominent style proves perfectly suited to exploiting any hesitation from the hold-up horses.

watchPoints.text: Town Queen could dominate if allowed an uncontested lead given her higher rating and recent race fitness
Distant Shore's 283-day absence is a significant concern despite her winning form when last seen
Perfect Ruler's 175-day break for the Haggas yard could produce improvement but recent form suggests limited ability
The three hold-up horses may struggle if the pace becomes too tactical for their running styles
Connor Beasley's 25% strike rate for the Bethell yard adds minor interest to Porth Eilian's chances

races.paceDynamic: Flight Plan is the sole confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable pace without early pressure. Behind him, six horses want prominent positions creating a dangerous traffic jam: Sea Force, Blue Rc, Mirsky, City Of Poets, Esherann, A War Eagle and Bellarchi will all be scrapping for the same real estate. This congestion will intensify 2-3 furlongs out as they fan across the track seeking racing room. The tactical dynamics clearly favour the hold-up horses who can avoid the prominent melee and time their challenges from deeper positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prosper
scenarios.trigger: If Flight Plan sets moderate fractions and the prominent pack gets tangled up
scenarios.body: The early pace will be steady enough for closers to make ground while the prominent runners compromise each other in a scramble for position. Al Mubhir, Apiarist and Witch Hunter can pick their way through from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent battle royal
scenarios.trigger: If the six prominent runners engage in sustained early warfare
scenarios.body: Flight Plan will be dragged into a faster pace than ideal while the prominent pack burns energy fighting each other. Blue Rc or Sea Force could emerge from the carnage if they secure clean passages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Flight Plan dominates throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack hesitates early allowing Flight Plan easy fractions
scenarios.body: He'll have too much petrol left when the prominent runners finally engage, making him hard to peg back in the straight. The lack of early pace pressure plays into his hands perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Flight Plan goes too slow and the prominent pack refuses to engage
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the fastest horse on the day wins regardless of position. Any runner with tactical pace could prevail from this messy scenario.

watchPoints.text: Watch for severe traffic problems 2-3 furlongs out when Sea Force, Blue Rc, Mirsky, City Of Poets, Esherann and A War Eagle all converge seeking racing room
Flight Plan could steal this if the prominent pack hesitates to engage early and allows him soft sectionals
Al Mubhir's 225-day absence is a major concern for a hold-up horse needing peak fitness to deliver his finishing kick
Blue Rc and City Of Poets both trained by James Tate whose 8% recent strike rate masks the quality when his runners are primed
Several 3lb and 7lb claimers riding which could prove decisive in a tight handicap finish

races.paceDynamic: Shipshape is the only natural pace-setter in this small field and will dictate terms from the front without pressure. The four hold-up horses (Analogical, Ashdown Forest, Marbuzet, Scottish Dancer) will track behind in a compact group, creating a tactical waiting game. With no pace pressure on Shipshape early, the race will develop into a sustained gallop that builds from the home turn. This shape heavily favours front-running and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will emerge when four hold-up horses try to find racing room simultaneously.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Shipshape Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Shipshape maintains a controlled lead without being challenged early.
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to dictate ideal fractions and kick clear when the hold-up brigade get organised too late. Traffic issues behind compound the problem as four horses with similar styles bunch up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four hold-up horses all get blocked or hampered in the straight.
scenarios.body: Multiple runners with identical tactics create a messy finish where positioning becomes crucial and several never get clear runs. The best-positioned hold-up horse capitalises on others' misfortune.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Shipshape goes too fast early or stops quickly in the straight.
scenarios.body: His prominent style backfires when overly aggressive tactics leave him vulnerable, allowing the classiest hold-up horse to sweep past with a perfectly-timed run.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Scottish Revival
scenarios.trigger: If Scottish Dancer shows unexpected improvement after his long absence.
scenarios.body: The 7-year-old finds his best form despite the 1065-day layoff and times his challenge perfectly while others struggle with pace or traffic.

watchPoints.text: Scottish Dancer's market support despite the 1065-day absence - any money suggests connections expect significant improvement
Traffic problems in the straight when four hold-up horses converge - whoever gets the clearest passage gains decisive advantage
Shipshape's early pace judgment - if Connor Beasley goes too fast he'll set it up for the hold-up horses behind
Analogical's weight burden at 139lbs compared to others in the 127-132lb range - class needs to overcome the penalty
Marbuzet's fitness after 203-day break against more race-fit opponents in small competitive field

races.paceDynamic: Kosometsuke is the sole natural front-runner in this field and should get his own way on the lead without pressure. The prominent racers Kats Bob, Emperor Caradoc, Sugar Baby and Mr Dreamseller will sit just behind, while the hold-up contingent of Aberama Gold, Mister Sox, Rock Opera and Khabib will track from the rear. With minimal early pace pressure, Kosometsuke can dictate fractions and the race is likely to develop into a sprint finish over the final furlong. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical pace who can position prominently and have a sustained kick, as the slow early gallop will leave plenty in the tank for a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Kosometsuke gets soft fractions and maintains his kick
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets first run and holds off late closers who leave their move too late. Prominent racers who can track the pace without over-racing benefit most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady but prominent runners time their moves perfectly
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop sets up perfectly for horses sitting in the box seat to strike approaching the final furlong. Those with tactical speed from prominent positions prove too strong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Hero Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely crawling and becomes a pure sprint
scenarios.body: The slow tempo allows hold-up horses to get into contention despite their preferred style being compromised. Class and finishing kick become the deciding factors over positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Kosometsuke ties up dramatically or the pace is funeral-slow
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair where positioning matters less than raw ability and luck in running. Any style can prevail in the scramble.

watchPoints.text: Kosometsuke getting uncontested fractions - if Connor Beasley can dictate a comfortable tempo, he becomes extremely hard to pass
Sugar Baby's fitness after 161-day break - if sharp despite the layoff, her prominent style and course form make her dangerous
Kats Bob's headgear working - veteran has the class and style to win this if the visor sharpens him up
The pace development in the first two furlongs - if genuinely crawling, it transforms the race into a lottery sprint
Aberama Gold's position turning for home - if David O'Meara's hold-up specialist is closer than usual, the pace has gone wrong

races.paceDynamic: Tatterstall will take this group along from the front as the only confirmed front runner, setting what should be a workable tempo over this straight five furlongs at Thirsk. The prominent runners Vantheman, Equity Law, Brazen Bolt, Kinetic Force and American Bay will track just behind, with the hold-up horses Toca Madera, Elegant Erin, Wheels Of Fire, Squealer and Sports Coach needing to find gaps and time their runs from the rear. With only one horse wanting the lead and good ground conditions favouring sustained speed, this race shape clearly favours the prominent racers who can sit close enough to strike but avoid any early pressure that Tatterstall might face.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack can settle nicely behind Tatterstall's sustainable pace
scenarios.body: The trackers will have ideal positioning to pounce in the final furlong as Tatterstall tires, with American Bay and Equity Law perfectly placed to capitalize. Their racing styles are tailor-made for this tactical setup over the minimum trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Time Perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and the prominent runners get drawn into it
scenarios.body: The closers will benefit from a collapse up front, with Sports Coach and Wheels Of Fire having the class to sweep past tired leaders. Both have shown they can quicken decisively when the tempo suits.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tatterstall Wires The Field
scenarios.trigger: If Tatterstall gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The front runner will prove impossible to peg back with such a soft setup, maintaining his advantage all the way to the line. His stamina will outlast the challengers' finishing speed over this sharp track.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Tatterstall goes too slowly and creates a sprint finish from the two-furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test where the fastest finishers can overcome poor positioning, giving Vantheman and Kinetic Force chances despite tactical disadvantages. Raw speed trumps positioning in this scenario.

watchPoints.text: Tatterstall faces significant fitness concerns after 247 days off despite being the only natural leader in this field.
American Bay represents Paul Midgley who has 0/7 recent form but the booking of Barry McHugh suggests stable confidence in this runner.
Wheels Of Fire carries Tyrese Cameron's 5lb claim which could be crucial in a tight finish and suggests Richard Hannon expects a bold show.
Equity Law has winning course form and represents Tim Easterby's yard in decent form but must overcome a quick turnaround from seven days ago.
Vantheman wears blinkers for Kevin Ryan but the stable's 5/29 form means he needs to bounce back to his best to be competitive here.

races.paceDynamic: Pension Pot will set the early pace with Law Supreme, Lightning Galaxy, Thats My Boy Luke and Front Gunner all positioned prominently behind. The modest early gallop will allow the hold-up horses Rising Force, Sunny Orange, Kiss Me My Love and Off Spin to settle closer than usual on this tight Thirsk circuit. The pace will gradually build through the middle sections before quickening significantly in the final 2f as the prominent runners kick and the closers launch their challenges. This moderate early tempo followed by a strong finish favours horses with tactical speed who can position handy and finish - the prominent runners hold a clear tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays reasonable and the prominent quartet get first run
scenarios.body: Law Supreme and Thats My Boy Luke can use their class and tactical positioning to control the race from the front rank. The hold-up horses will find the gaps closing as the pace lifts approaching the home turn.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the prominent horses tie up
scenarios.body: Sunny Orange and Rising Force can exploit their hold-up styles as the early leaders weaken in the final furlong. The strong pace will set up perfectly for their finishing kicks from off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pension Pot Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Pension Pot gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The 4yo can use the moderate early gallop to conserve energy before quickening decisively when the race begins in earnest. His recent Redcar second suggests he retains enough ability to exploit soft fractions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Storm Home
scenarios.trigger: If a genuine end-to-end gallop develops with multiple pace angles engaged
scenarios.body: Kiss Me My Love and Off Spin can benefit from a truly-run race that stretches the field and creates maximum opportunities for late runners. The strong gallop will play directly into their patient riding tactics.

watchPoints.text: Law Supreme could get perfect stalking position if Pension Pot sets steady fractions and may prove hard to peg back
Lightning Galaxy's fitness after 176-day layoff - any market moves would be significant given the extended absence
Rising Force's ability to get competitive position from stall draw on tight Thirsk bends with inexperienced claimer aboard
Sunny Orange's early positioning as hold-up horse needs to avoid getting too far back on this sharp track
Front Gunner stepping up to mile for first time in months - trip extension could expose stamina limitations
